🔥 netviz | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Visually designing and animating network architectures in a browser.
✨ Key Features: • Drag and drop blocks or insert production templates • Connect blocks with edges • Build and tune custom request-flow animations • Preview animations with optional camera follow • Inspector panel to edit selected items
📖 Summary: Netviz is a browser-based application for visually designing and animating network architectures. It allows users to add components, map data flow, and create animated request paths for presentations.
